title: Size of the Overpayment Notice Measured against the Capitation Payment — Network Participation Agreements
content:
This Payment Integrity note applies to continuing capitation withholdings on a Cascade DHMO Primary Care Dentist Agreement under the **Network Participation Agreements**. When the overpayment being recovered is large compared with the capitation payment it is withheld from, the share withheld rises.

**Clause.** The notice-size adjustment to the continuing capitation withholding share is set by the notice amount of the overpayment under recovery, measured against the capitation amount:

- a notice amount of at least twice the capitation amount adds 10 share points;
- a notice amount of at least the capitation amount but less than twice it adds 5 share points;
- a smaller notice amount adds nothing.

## Terms

- **Overpayment under recovery.** The overpayment that the agreement's most recent withholding was applied to.
- **Notice amount.** The amount on that overpayment's notice, as first issued. Later withholdings, refunds or reductions do not change it for this measure.
- **Capitation amount.** The amount of the agreement's most recent capitation payment.

Where two ledger entries share the latest date, the one listed first on the agreement's ledger is taken.

## Worked judgements (hypothetical amounts)

| Capitation amount | Notice amount | Ratio band | Share points added |
|---|---|---|---|
| 7110.00 USD | 7109.99 USD | Below the capitation amount | None |
| 7110.00 USD | 7110.00 USD | At least the capitation amount, less than twice it | 5 |
| 7110.00 USD | 14219.99 USD | At least the capitation amount, less than twice it | 5 |
| 7110.00 USD | 14220.00 USD | At least twice the capitation amount | 10 |
